text:
mike: FYI I hit a nasty bundler parity issue while onboarding a new user with our TS sampleapp. Vite dev server is fine but the SSR build targeting Edge fails at runtime.

anya: whats the runtime error?

mike: preview-edge logs: "SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module" referencing node internals. Local node (CJS compat) runs fine. We import SDK as `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`.

paul: likely packaging: if package.json only exposes ./package.json in exports and still has main/module fields, bundlers can pick different entrypoints. do you have the package.json?

mike: grabbed from node_modules: `main: dist/index.cjs.js`, `module: dist/index.esm.js`, `types: dist/index.d.ts`, `exports: { "./package.json": "./package.json" }`.

anya: yep. Vite/ESBuild SSR sometimes resolves to main (CJS) and edge runtime expects ESM semantics -> crash. Webpack or Rollup behave differently; TS can also fail to find types if exports doesn't surface them.

paul: repro I used: minimal index.server.ts imports SDK, `npm i`, then `vite build --ssr` and `node dist/server/index.js` -> same runtime error. For webpack SSR I saw build succeed but `tsc --noEmit` complains about missing declaration file.

mike: short-term workaround in sampleapp: add Vite alias to force ESM entry: `resolve.alias: { '@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.esm.js' }`. For webpack set `resolve.mainFields = ['browser','module','main']`. Add note to README.

anya: proper fix: update SDK package exports to an explicit map exposing import/require/types/browser. e.g. "exports": { "./package.json":"./package.json", "./": { "import":"./dist/index.esm.js","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts","browser":"./dist/index.browser.js" } }. Also add typesVersions for older TS.

paul: CI: add packaging smoke tests that install built tarball and run `vite build --ssr`, `rollup -c ssr.rollup.js`, `webpack --config ssr.webpack.js`, and `tsc --noEmit`. Fail the release on regressions.

pkg-bot: opened sdk-packaging#321: "exports map + bundler smoke tests for ESM/CJS parity".

mike: thanks. I'll draft the PR to add the exports map + small CI job and include a tiny repro and README blurb to help onboarders.

anya: thumbs up. this should prevent a lot of onboarding friction. :+1:
